hypothesis: Y059's deterministic public rotating sentinel detects 3/4 future nonaffine coordinate-swap regimes at equal scalar reading cost. Test a bounded causal decoder correction that infers swap partner from only current sentinel residual and the historical affine public anchor model. It should correct the mapping AFTER detecting a physical 2↔3 or 4↔5 transposition without oracle swap/onset input. The known 2↔3 onset6 timing miss must remain uncorrectable, and no pre-detection improvements are credited.
freeze: Freeze disjoint development seeds3136..3143, sealed heldout3144..3159 (16), 4 new odd affine background families, two fixed nonaffine transpositions 2↔3 and 4↔5, regimes steady/onset4/onset6, 8-episode horizon. Fixed 10 public scalar reads via same Y059 schedule (0/1 at e0,e1,e3; 0/2 e5; 0/4 e7). At first nonzero residual, infer the paired cell by applying affine baseline inverse to the OBSERVED sentinel label, remember one transposition (two cell IDs), and apply inverse transposition to the *decoded physical IDs* of any subsequently presented encoded coordinate. No further sensing, no hindsight. Compare fixed anchor-only decoder and rotating-sentinel no-correction versus rotating-sentinel with causal correction on the exact same source-coded 16-cell permutations at each of eight episodes, retaining all per-episode/per-cell errors. The all-16 oracle source is supplied to EVALUATOR ONLY to score decoded IDs, never to the model's adaptation function.
classification: CAUSAL_DECODER_RECOVERY iff both detectable post-onset cases 2_3:onset4 and4_5:onset4 and 4_5:onset6 have >=90% decrease in post-detection decoder errors relative to detect_only, steady all arms zero, missed 2_3:onset6 remains missed, and 10 readings per trial held. PARTIAL_DECODER_RECOVERY iff >=1 detectable case achieves >=50% post-detection error reduction under steady zero; NO_GAIN otherwise. Preserve all blind, pre-detection and adverse outcomes.
controls: Only current precommitted sentinel measurements and earlier observed public anchor0/1 linear calibration feed learner. No source-truth cell pair, onset or future data available to inference function; simulator gives source labels ONLY to evaluator for scoring.
A corrected *decoder* is not matching controller recovery, cache repair, 7/9 capacity reuse or general autonomous biological cognition. Matching actuator and source-level worker remain unchanged.

No extra readings; physically addressable sentinel cells 2 and4 are a new sensing-capability requirement despite same count. Detection/localization uses known affine baseline and assumes true disturbance is a single transposition.
Prereg and frozen code SHA before first use, original archive, one full pytest regression, no accepted-ref or authority mutation.
claim_limit: Deterministic single-swap synthetic decoder-side correction after public detection; does not establish actual retained-state repair or general self-maintenance.
